blocks.text: That oversight is precisely why printing remains one of the largest hidden expenses in modern corporate budgets.

Every invoice, contract, procurement order, and client presentation moves through your office copier. For mid-sized to large enterprises printing thousands of pages each month, these daily print jobs quietly accumulate into a significant yearly expense. The purchase price of hardware is rarely the issue; the true driver of long-term printing expenditure comes down to a vital financial metric: Cost Per Page (CPP).
The True Cost of Color Printing

blocks.text: For years, local enterprises using traditional color laser copiers have absorbed an industry-standard CPP of ₱4 to ₱10 per page for color output. Multiplicopied across various departments over a fiscal quarter, paying up to ten pesos per sheet transforms basic document workflow into a heavy recurring liability. To control these ballooning overhead costs, many executives implement strict printing restrictions, forcing employees to rely on monochrome printouts for crucial client meetings and marketing proposals.
Epson is fundamentally changing that financial reality.
With the Epson WorkForce EM-C8100, companies can now produce sharp, high-impact color documents at a groundbreaking CPP of less than ₱1 per page.
Benchmarking the traditional market average of ₱4–₱10 against Epson’s sub-₱1 CPP alters the financial math for corporate decision-makers:
Sales & Marketing: Deliver vibrant pitch decks and leave-behinds that reflect brand quality without budget concerns.
HR & Administration: Produce vivid onboarding manuals and policy updates that keep employees engaged.
Finance: Lower the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) while drastically cutting monthly
consumable expenses.
When color printing drops below one peso per page, businesses no longer need to sacrifice presentation quality to stay within budget.
Built for High-Volume Enterprise Demands

Beyond unit economics, the Epson WorkForce EM-C8100 functions as a heavy-duty 4-in-1 multifunction partner designed to handle the daily demands of fast-paced workgroups: ● Ultra-High Yield Consumables: Print thousands of pages before requiring ink replacements, significantly lowering maintenance interventions and administrative hassle.

Epson Heat-Free Technology: Unlike conventional laser models that rely on high heat to fuse toner onto paper, Epson’s precision Heat-Free system consumes far less electricity, utilizes fewer replacement parts, and delivers fast first-page-out times.
An Essential Operational Investment
In any enterprise, certain tools quietly keep daily operations moving forward. The office copier serves every department—from Accounting and Human Resources to Operations and Supply Chain.

Upgrading from an outdated, high-CPP unit to the Epson WorkForce EM-C8100 isn’t just a hardware purchase; it is a direct cost-reduction strategy that enables Philippine businesses to lower overhead, boost daily productivity, and work smarter.
